title: Sourcing & Category Expert Infrastructure Software
full_description:
Sourcing & Category Management
Amsterdam, Netherlands
€6.500,60 - €10.389,47
At ING, procurement is about collaboration, innovation, and creating strategic impact that drives sustainable growth. We are a global organization in the CFO domain with a presence in more than 20 countries. We embed responsible practices, and deliver solutions that touch every part of the organization. If you thrive in a dynamic environment, approach challenges with curiosity, and want to help shape what’s next, this is your opportunity to make a real difference.
The teamGroup Technology Procurement Category forms part of the Group Procurement organization, it’s lead by Head of Group Technology Procurement. Category Management is a critical procurement discipline within Procurement Organisation to ensure ING achieves best value for money when it comes to procuring its goods and services. It is a well-established, comprehensive, and marketing leading procurement approach that considers ING’s organisational goals, technology strategy, objectives , and requirements, as well as the technology market conditions and innovations, to ensure the most cost-effective, innovative and efficient procurement of goods and services. Technology category consists of Global Category Leads, Sourcing and Category Experts, Sourcing and Contracting experts, Sourcing Project Managers and SAM team.
In this pivotal role where you’ll join a newly formed, high-performing team of specialists. Reporting directly to theGlobal Category Lead for Infrastructure Software, you’ll have the opportunity to influence strategic decisions and deliver results that matter on a global scale.
As a Sourcing and Category Expert Infrastructure Software,you will:
Create the sourcing execution approachand drive results across global spend categories.
Manage critical and strategic contracts, ensuring compliance and value delivery.
Develop and execute bank-wide vendor strategiesfor assigned critical and strategic vendors, influencing decisions at the highest level.
This is your opportunity to lead sourcing execution on a global scale, work with strategic partners, and deliver solutions that matter.
Join us if you want to be part of the next chapter of procurement journey at ING.
Roles and responsibilitiesCategory Management & Expertise
Identify business needs, category specifications, and vendor requirements to shape vendor plans.
Provide strategic insights for category plans based on portfolio developments.
Leverage your expertise to lead high-impact negotiations with designated vendors.
Define global and local business needs for sourcing projects and vendor relationships.
Design and manage sourcing events, including the full RFX process—prepare documentation, train suppliers, issue RFX, and consolidate responses.
Negotiate and finalize contracts, ensuring terms and conditions meet business objectives.
Oversee contract approvals, supplier onboarding, and compliance checks.
Support Procurement Operations with vendor master data and contract lifecycle management.
Build and execute vendor plans with clear objectives, fostering strong supplier relationships and driving innovation.
Act as a senior sourcing subject matter expert, executing complex initiatives and advising on strategic opportunities.
Partner with category managers on stakeholder engagement, strategic initiatives, and supplier segmentation.
Ensure contract and third-party risk compliance across all activities.
Vendor Management for Strategic Partners
Lead negotiations for major scope changes and renewals, maintaining deep knowledge of commercial and contractual developments.
Monitor supplier performance, conduct quality assessments, and ensure compliance with contractual terms.
Drive continuous improvement and risk mitigation in vendor relationships.
Execute complex sourcing projects, manage global initiatives, and advise senior stakeholders.
Navigate multi-stakeholder landscapes to balance value, flexibility, and risk.
Negotiate with monopolistic or oligopolistic software vendors, creating leverage in pricing and contract terms.
Develop strategies to avoid vendor lock-in and increase long-term flexibility.
How to succeedWe hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.
Furthermore, you have:
3-6 years in Procurement area at a strategic level in an international organisation (preferably financial services provider).
3+ years cross country negotiations for group wide vendors such as Microsoft, Broadcom (previously Vmware), Oracle, IBM, hyperscalers.
Deep understanding of software market trends, dynamics and competitive landscapes. Ability to gather and interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable strategies, defining opportunities for growth and optimize category strategies. Thorough understanding of all license models across Enterprise vendors as Microsoft, Broadcom, Oracle, IBM, hyperscalers is a must, SAP, FIS, core-banking, investment baking applications, or other software vendors is preferred.
Experience working with offshore teams.
Master English business language/communication (spoken as well as written)
Strong project management skills to align with multiple stakeholders
Strong negotiation skills
Regulatory and Compliance aspects of procurement in finance organisation
Deep up-to-date knowledge of commercial and contractual developments for assigned vendors
Strategic mindset: develop and execute best in class sourcing strategies with involvement of Business stakeholders
Influencing and conflict resolution skills
Agile and self-driven
Drive sustainable Procurement
Rewards and benefitsWe want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life.Find out more about our employment conditions.
